offering_description.value: Smart Sand mines, washes, dries and grades silica sand for oil and gas producers, oilfield service firms and industrial customers. It ships sand by rail and truck and supplies mobile equipment for storing and handling sand at wellsites.

primary_products.value: Northern White frac sand; graded industrial silica sand

primary_services.value: Frac sand transportation and transloading; mobile wellsite sand storage and handling equipment rental

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas producers, pressure-pumping and oilfield service companies, and industrial silica buyers

end_markets.value: Oil and gas well completions; glass manufacturing; foundries; building products; filtration

revenue_model.value: product sales: Frac sand and graded industrial silica sand; service fees: Sand transportation and transloading; rental or leasing: Mobile sand storage and handling equipment for wellsites
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: Mines and grades silica sand for oilfield and industrial customers; asset operator: Operates sand mines, processing plants and transload terminals that supply customers; service provider: Coordinates sand shipments and supplies mobile handling equipment to well completion crews
value_chain_position.category: raw materials; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: North America: U.S. and Canadian markets, with mining and processing in Wisconsin and Illinois

specialization.value: related lines: Frac sand, industrial silica sand, and proppant logistics and handling equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Supply agreements and spot sales to oilfield and industrial customers; own locations: Rail loadouts at company mines and company-operated transload terminals for truck pickup

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Sand mining and processing are subject to MSHA mine safety rules and state and federal environmental permits.

notes: The current extent of Canadian sales is uncertain.
